roots.value: Plan the splashback at the same time as the worktop. Tiles, glass and upstands each need a different gap at the wall, and the supplier will ask for the finished thickness.

roots.value: Appliance cut-outs must be confirmed against the manufacturer's drawings, not the brochure. An integrated oven needs ventilation behind the housing, and a hob needs clearance below for the cables.

roots.value: Schedule the electrician for first fix before the plasterer and for second fix after the painter.
